notes.title: Zoo Strikers Ape Collective LIVE Press Conference
notes.notes:
Zoo Strikers is holding the very first Ape Collective Stream for its open alpha demo! 

The Ape Collective will be broadcasted on the 16th with the release of the demo, and include famous
musicians, reveals, and announcements for not only Zoo Strikers, but other upcoming games!

There's more to come after the Ape Collective press conference, with live streams by the developers coming later during the steam games festival, as well as streams by some of your favourite internet influencers!
